compositionEvidence.summary: Draft composes accepted WebGPU-compatible parts into an asymmetric all-over field of vertical repetition, diagonal current, warm/dark pressure, dry grain, sparse notation, and shallow surround.
decisions: Camera fields are returned unchanged; framing is solved with part position, scale, and slight yaw only.
The primary vertical-field part is enlarged and shifted left so the desktop frame reads as an edge-to-edge structure rather than an inset panel.
The tilted-wedge and dark-warm parts cross the vertical field from different depths to carry the athletics news as slow concentrated planar flow.
Painted-surface grain is layered over the main planes at reduced opacity so material evidence is visible without hiding structure.
Contour notations are pulled closer and enlarged to survive full-world integration while preserving their line-accent ownership.
The slow-grid-pulse-depth part is pushed farther left/back to create shallow surround cadence rather than foreground spectacle.
Output grade uses one subtle renderer-owned contrast/exposure/saturation lift and avoids stacking post effects or material color compensation.

takeaways: Treat final color as a single renderer-owned output transform, not a repair layer for transforms.
Use fixed supplied camera and the required desktop/mobile/surround Playwright captures as the deterministic validation evidence.
